calculation_steps: Construct the full 0/1/2 oriented incidence generator on each quotient and the same A0 plus B-neighbor directional packet.
Iterate exact integer derivatives to order17 for the base and two directional components; verify rotated trajectories match derivatives at each order.
Differentiate J=2diag(y)B1^T x with binomial convolution and retain cross terms linear in epsilon, dividing by order factorial.
Compare rational matrices: common through s7; first N7/N13 difference at s9 and N13/N19 difference at s13.

counterexamples_and_failures: All N7/13/19 activate at first order; a supplied direction is not a seven-cell selector.
The preceding selected one-edge gate has a different quotient onset (s7); the two preparations are not the same model.
An arbitrary packet amplitude and material bath could reproduce varied friction responses, so no force residual is identified.
A finite skew generator has no Ohmic drag or load slope on its own.
